subject: Ignite.ai POC Kickstart — hands-on session scheduling and action log
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha@ignite.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Wu <tom.wu@ignite.ai>
Date: 2027-08-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Ignite POC — kickoff

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for moving quickly. We would like to get a hands-on POC kickstart this week to walk through our prompts, validate routing, and run a small surge load test. High-level asks:
- Review current prompt set (customer facing + internal routing prompts)
- Validate policy routing and fallbacks with short sequences (~256 tokens)
- Run a 15–30 minute load sweep at representative QPS (we can provide a small test harness)

Are you available for a 90–120 minute working session this week? Our preferred windows (PST): Tue 11:00–13:00, Wed 09:00–11:00, Thu 14:00–16:00. We can also provide an SSO user, test dataset, and a short README for the harness.

Tom from our engineering team will join. Can you confirm who from Redwood should attend and if you need any access in advance?

Best,
Samantha
Samantha Lee
Head of Product, Ignite.ai
[samantha@ignite.ai]
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@ignite.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-01T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Ignite POC — kickoff

Hi Samantha — thanks for the clear asks. We can support all three areas in a single 90–120 minute session. Proposed attendees from Redwood: myself (product + sales engineering), Vanessa (solutions engineer — prompts & routing), Dev (runtime lead — load test owner), and Olga (integration engineer — networking/SSO).

We can do Tue 11:00–13:00 PST or Wed 09:00–11:00 PST; Thu looks tight for our infra cycle. If Tue works for you we will block a 2-hour slot and plan the agenda: 15m intros, 30m prompt review + small rewrites, 30m routing/fallback validation, 25m load sweep and analysis.

Before the session please send: test harness README, a sample of the prompt set (anonymized if needed), and any temporary SSO/test accounts. Also confirm the nominal QPS target for the sweep and whether you want token-level logging enabled.

I'll create the calendar invite after you confirm.

- Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Samantha Lee <samantha@ignite.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Wu <tom.wu@ignite.ai>
Date: 2027-08-02T08:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Ignite POC — kickoff

Hi Karthik — thanks. Quick update: internal stakeholder meeting pushed part of our Tue morning block; can we shift to Tue 11:00–13:00 -> Tue 11:00–13:00 was our preferred but we now need 11:00–13:00 to move one hour later to 12:00–14:00 (PST). If that won't work for Redwood, Wed 09:00–11:00 is still fine.

Target QPS for sweep: 8–12 QPS (burst to 20 for short 60s spike). Please enable token-level logging for the sweep and keep logs retained for 7 days. We'll attach the harness README and a redacted prompt set in a follow-up email.

Tom will bring the sample dataset. Sorry for the churn — let us know which slot you prefer and we'll finalize the invite.

Thanks,
Samantha
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@ignite.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-02T10:30:00-07:00
Subject: Confirm: Tue 2027-08-04 12:00–14:00 PST (Ignite POC)

Samantha — no problem, we can shift one hour. Confirmed: Tue 2027-08-04 12:00–14:00 PST (90–120m slot). I've created the calendar event and attached a working agenda and the initial runbook (v1). Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=ignite-poc-20270804-1100

Agenda (working)
- 12:00–12:10: Intros & success criteria (Samantha/Tom / Karthik)
- 12:10–12:40: Prompt review — Vanessa leads (redaction + suggested edits)
- 12:40–13:10: Routing & fallback validation — Olga leads (policy checks)
- 13:10–13:40: Load sweep — Dev leads (8–12 QPS baseline, 60s spike to 20)
- 13:40–13:55: Quick analysis & next steps

Pre-reads attached: ignite_poc_runbook_v1.pdf, prompt-deck-ignite.pptx. Dev — we'll want token-level logging enabled for the sweep and a pre-check on the KV cache warm-up strategy. Vanessa — please prepare 3 prioritized prompt cases (happy path, ambiguous, adversarial)

If anything changes I'll update the invite. Looking forward to the session.

- Karthik
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@ignite.ai>, Tom Wu <tom.wu@ignite.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-04T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Ignite POC — session recap and immediate action items

Thanks everyone for a productive session today. Short recap and owners below — notes attached as post-session-action-log.csv and updated runbook link (see Drive). Recording: https://drive.google.com/ignite-poc/session-20270804-recording

What we ran
- Prompt review: 3 cases reviewed; Vanessa recorded suggested rewrites and a safety hold for one ambiguous prompt
- Routing: validated policy route + fallback to small-cap model for cold-starts; Olga confirmed header-preserving routing works for our client use-case
- Load sweep: baseline 10 QPS for 10m, 60s spike to 20 QPS — no token OOMs; observed 2x latency increase during spike but within target SLO for the degraded tier

Immediate action items
- Vanessa: produce finalized prompt deck with revisions (due 2027-08-09)
- Dev: prepare a runbook snippet for load-sweep tuning and enable token-level logging retention 7 days (due 2027-08-06)
- Olga: share SSO test-user config and network egress checklist (due 2027-08-06)
- Karthik/Marissa: draft mutual action plan and narrow success metrics for the pilot (due 2027-08-11)

Notes and next steps
- We suggested an 90-minute follow-up workshop to instrument longer-running episodes and measure cache hit rate — Samantha proposed Aug 12 morning PST.
- Dev will open a short support ticket with infra team to adjust memory thresholds; ticket id will be added to HubSpot.

Attachments: post-session-action-log.csv, updated runbook (Drive).

Thanks — great collaboration.
- Karthik
From: Samantha Lee <samantha@ignite.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Wu <tom.wu@ignite.ai>
Date: 2027-08-05T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Ignite POC — session recap and immediate action items

Karthik — thanks for the crisp recap and for moving quickly on the action items. Confirming we received the prompts and recording. Aug 12 for the follow-up works for us — can we target 09:00–10:30 PST to capture our APAC participants? Please assign calendar invite and we will confirm Tom's availability.

Action confirmations:
- Vanessa: we expect the finalized prompt deck by EOD 8/9
- Dev: please confirm token logging retention is set and share the short runbook snippet when ready
- Olga: we will test SSO using the config you shared on 8/6 and report any issues by EOD 8/9

Thanks again — excited for the next round.

Best,
Samantha
